problem.name: k-sum
problem.statement_latex: Given $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ in a finite abelian group and a target $t$, find distinct $i_1,\ldots,i_k$ with $\sum_{j=1}^k x_{i_j}=t$, or report that none exist. Here $k$ is constant and group elements are supplied by an indexed oracle.
problem.statement_text: Given $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ in a finite abelian group and a target $t$, find distinct $i_1,\ldots,i_k$ with $\sum_{j=1}^k x_{i_j}=t$, or report that none exist. Here $k$ is constant and group elements are supplied by an indexed oracle.

quantum.headline_latex: $O(n^{k/(k+1)})$ input queries by the subset quantum walk. This is tight for sufficiently large groups.
quantum.headline_text: $O(n^{k/(k+1)})$ input queries by the subset quantum walk. This is tight for sufficiently large groups.

classical.headline_latex: $\Theta(n)$ queries, followed by classical processing. Meet-in-the-middle gives $\widetilde O(n^{\lceil k/2\rceil})$ time for fixed $k$; query and arithmetic bounds measure different resources.
